notFound.title: This course can't be edited
notFound.body: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to someone else.

banner.rejected: A reviewer returned this course for changes. Edit it, then submit it again.
banner.pendingReview: This course is waiting for review, so it can't be edited until the review is done.
banner.published: This course is published. Editing published courses isn't available yet, so this view is read-only.
banner.archived: This course is archived and can't be edited.

save.invalid: Not saved yet: complete the highlighted fields

field.tooLong: This is too long. Shorten it to save.

details.title: Course title
details.descriptionHint: Plain text. Say what learners will be able to do afterwards.
details.languageHint: The language the course is taught in.
details.durationHint: Leave empty if you're not sure.
details.tagsHint: Press Enter after each tag. Up to {{max}}.
details.thumbnailHint: A link to an image, starting with https://.

errors.duration: Enter the number of minutes as a whole number.
errors.tagTooLong: Keep each tag to 40 characters or fewer.

empty.title: Start with a module
empty.body: Modules group your videos, documents and exams into steps.

content.startHint: Add a module to start building the course.
content.selectHint: Choose a module or an item to edit it.

dnd.instructions: To reorder, press Space or Enter to pick up. Use the arrow keys to move, then press Space or Enter to drop, or Escape to cancel.
dnd.cancelled: Reordering cancelled. {{title}} is back where it was.

module.label: Module {{number}}
module.title: Module title
module.descriptionHint: Optional. A sentence about what this module covers.
module.deleteBody_one: Its {{count}} item is deleted too. This can't be undone.
module.deleteBody_other: Its {{count}} items are deleted too. This can't be undone.

addItem.title: Add an item to {{module}}
addItem.examHint: The exam starts empty. Add its settings and questions next.

item.title: Item title
item.deleteBody: Learners' progress on this item is lost. This can't be undone.

video.unavailable: YouTube reports this video as private, deleted or not embeddable. Replace it with another video.
video.linkHint: Copy the link from the video's Share button.

pdf.dropHint: Or drag a PDF here. Up to {{max}} MB.

errors.type: That isn't a PDF. Choose a PDF file.
errors.size: That file is larger than {{max}} MB. Choose a smaller file.

errors.percent: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
errors.positive: Enter a whole number of 1 or more, or leave it empty.

questions.title: Questions
questions.empty: This exam has no questions yet. Add at least one before submitting the course.
questions.maxAnswers: A question can have up to {{max}} answers.

errors.promptTooLong: Shorten the question to 10,000 characters or fewer.
errors.points: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
errors.choiceRequired: Enter the answer, or remove it.
errors.choiceTooLong: Shorten the answer to 2,000 characters or fewer.

review.checklistBody: An administrator reviews your course before learners can see it. Check these first.

check.NO_MODULES: The course has at least one module
check.EMPTY_MODULE: Every module has at least one item
check.EMPTY_EXAM: Every exam has at least one question

review.incompleteTitle: The course isn't ready for review yet:

problem.DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED: Add a description on the Details tab.
problem.EMPTY_MODULE: Add an item to every module, or delete empty modules.

review.unsaved: Some changes aren't saved yet. Wait until they're saved, or fix the highlighted fields, then submit.
review.submitHint: You can't edit the course while it's in review.
review.resubmitHint: The reviewer sees your changes. You can't edit the course while it's in review.
review.submitted: Submitted for review. You'll see the decision in My courses.
